name: aajke-ki-scene
description: Aajke Ki Scene? — Banglish-first AI-assisted news, current affairs and exam prep.

scripts.db:migrate: uv --directory backend run alembic -c api/alembic.ini upgrade head
scripts.db:seed: uv --directory backend run python -m app.cli seed-demo
scripts.dev:api: uv --directory backend run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --reload-dir api/app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000
scripts.dev:worker: uv --directory backend run python -m worker run
scripts.lint: npm run lint:py && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.lint:py: uv --directory backend run ruff check . ../scripts && uv --directory backend run ruff format --check . ../scripts
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck:py && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run test:py && npm run test --workspace frontend
